clips.title: Completion
paras: See this here seaweed, mon? It be from the South Seas. We just add a little mojo and a little magic and it takes on the properties most suited to its owner.
You an adventurer so it be easy, mon. Just wrap it around your neck and think of nature or squirrels or whatever it be that you people like.
